content.value_statement: Embedding choices affect retrieval quality, latency, and cost. This skill helps teams select models, chunk content, and evaluate search results for RAG systems.
actual_capabilities: Compares common embedding models by dimensions, token limits, and best use cases.
Provides OpenAI and local Sentence Transformers embedding templates.
Shows token, sentence, markdown section, and recursive chunking strategies.
Outlines domain-specific and code-oriented embedding pipelines.
Includes retrieval quality metrics such as precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG.
limitations: Does not benchmark models on your data automatically.
Requires users to supply provider credentials and local dependencies.
Code snippets are templates and may need fixes for production use.
Does not include vector database deployment guidance.

use_cases.title: Design a RAG Index
use_cases.description: Select an embedding model and chunk size before building a document retrieval workflow.

use_cases.title: Reduce Embedding Cost
use_cases.description: Compare smaller dimensions, batching, and caching choices for a cost-sensitive semantic search project.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Retrieval Quality
use_cases.description: Use retrieval metrics to compare model and chunking changes against labeled examples.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Use embedding-strategies to recommend an embedding model for [content type], [language], [scale], and [budget]. Explain tradeoffs for quality, cost, and latency.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Chunking
prompt_templates.prompt: Use embedding-strategies to design a chunking plan for [document format]. Include chunk size, overlap, metadata fields, and risks from truncation.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Embedding Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use embedding-strategies to outline an embedding pipeline for [domain]. Include preprocessing, batching, caching, metadata, and vector records.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Retrieval Experiments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use embedding-strategies to create an evaluation plan for [search problem]. Include datasets, relevance labels, metrics, baselines, and acceptance thresholds.

output_examples.input: User asks for a model for English SaaS help-center RAG with a moderate budget.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: start with a cost-effective cloud embedding model, use moderate chunk sizes with overlap, and measure retrieval quality before upgrading.

output_examples.input: User asks why semantic search misses long policy documents.
output_examples.output: Analysis: chunks may be too large or poorly aligned with document sections. Test section-aware chunking, preserve metadata, and compare recall on labeled queries.

output_examples.input: User asks how to evaluate two embedding models.
output_examples.output: Evaluation plan: create labeled query sets, run both indexes, compare precision, recall, MRR, and NDCG, then review cost and latency.

best_practices: Match the embedding model to content type, language, latency, and budget.
Preserve semantic boundaries when chunking and keep useful metadata with each vector.
Measure retrieval quality with labeled queries before changing production settings.
anti_patterns: Mixing embeddings from different models in the same index without reindexing.
Using one chunk size for every document format and domain.
Optimizing only benchmark scores while ignoring real user queries and cost.

faq.question: Does this skill generate embeddings itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and code templates for model selection, chunking, and evaluation.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content is tool-neutral and can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it require OpenAI?
faq.answer: No. It includes OpenAI examples and local Sentence Transformers examples.

faq.question: Can it choose a vector database?
faq.answer: It focuses on embeddings and retrieval quality. Vector database selection is outside its main scope.

faq.question: Is it suitable for multilingual search?
faq.answer: Yes. It discusses multilingual embedding models and prompts users to consider language coverage.

faq.question: Should I use the sample code directly in production?
faq.answer: No. Review dependencies, error handling, privacy, and provider limits before production use.
